translations.notice.durability_intro: Several factors influence the final outcome:
translations.notice.factor1: Your lifestyle, activity level, and overall health
translations.notice.factor2: Your individual nail features (structure, oiliness, growth rate)
translations.notice.factor3: The level of mechanical damage you expose your nails to
translations.notice.guarantee: We do not guarantee specific results for our work, including any predictions regarding how long a treatment will last.
translations.notice.hormonal_intro: Hormonal changes during pregnancy, breastfeeding, or the menstrual cycle may affect how long your service lasts.

translations.privacy.cookies_text: We use cookies and similar technologies to enhance your browsing experience. Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website.
translations.privacy.improve: To improve our services and tailor your experience
translations.privacy.info_text: We may collect the following types of information:
translations.privacy.name: Name
translations.privacy.respond: To respond to your inquiries and bookings
translations.privacy.rights_text: Under applicable data protection laws, you have the following rights: access and obtain a copy of your data on request; correct any inaccurate or incomplete data; request deletion of your data when it is no longer necessary for the purposes for which it was collected; restrict processing in certain circumstances; object to processing for direct marketing purposes.
translations.privacy.security_text: We implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorised access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.
translations.privacy.send: How we use your information — we use the information we collect to: process and confirm your appointment bookings; communicate with you about your appointment and related services
translations.privacy.service: Service details (type of treatment, appointment date/time)
translations.privacy.sharing_text: We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal data to third parties. We may share your information with: service providers who help us operate our booking system (such as our online scheduling platform); legal authorities when required by applicable law.
translations.privacy.use: Cookies & usage information (how you interact with our website, collected via standard web analytics tools)
translations.privacy.use_text: Contact information (name, phone number, email address, social media handle)
translations.services.brows_desc: From natural shaping and tinting to lamination that defines and lifts — expert brow and lash services that enhance your features with a clean, refined finish.

translations.services.general_desc: Every treatment is performed with care and precision. Choose a category to explore what we offer.
translations.services.laser_desc: Effective diode laser hair removal performed by trained professionals in a calm, clinical setting. Treatment packages designed for real, lasting results.
translations.services.manicure_desc: Clean, precise manicure care — from classic polish to structured gel — tailored to your nail health and style. Every finish is checked under magnification.
translations.services.pedicure_desc: Thorough, hygienic pedicure treatments that focus on foot health, comfort, and a polished look. Performed with attention to detail and a gentle touch.
translations.services.subtitle: Timeless beauty with a personal touch. Each service is designed with your comfort and confidence in mind.
translations.story_text: Aesthetic Lab opened its doors in 2024 with a simple promise — to do beautiful work in a space that feels genuinely calm, honest, and welcoming. Every service is performed with precision and care, every detail considered. We listen first, then create.
